## Rising Temperature
Given a dataset of daily temperatures, how do we find which days were hotter than the previous one?
Ques:- Write a solution in pyspark to find all dates' id with higher temperatures compared to its previous dates (yesterday).
data = [
 (1, "2015-01-01", 10),
 (2, "2015-01-02", 25),
 (3, "2015-01-03", 20),
 (4, "2015-01-04", 30)
]

schema = StructType([
 StructField("id", IntegerType(), True),
 StructField("recordDate", StringType(), True),
 StructField("temperature", IntegerType(), True)
])

df = spark.createDataFrame(data, schema)

Note : Do not use window function

O/P:-
+---+
| Id|
+---+
| 2|
| 4|
+---+
